messages:
Jana (PM): Quick thread to lock a smaller Q2 scope for the Optimize toolkit. Customers want batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Proposal: Phase 1 = non-invasive advisor (suggestions only) + opt-in eval webhook + pilot runbook.

Eric (Eng): Sounds safe. Key is advisor never changes runtime behavior in Phase 1. Emit JSON recs and rollout steps only.

Maria (ML): Alert set for MVP: per-prompt accuracy drop, p95 latency spike, token-cost anomaly. Use rolling 7-day baseline + hybrid thresholds to avoid noise.

Tom (SE): For quant recommend presets (SAFE_INT8, FP16_CONSERVATIVE). Include fallback_model_key and rollback snippet in each rec.

Priya (CS): Customers Alpha & Kanga can pilot. They want per-route caching advice and a guided onboarding doc. I'll prepare pilot template.

Jana (PM): Acceptance gates: <5% overhead, <=5 false positives/day in pilot, 2 pilots onboarded, onboarding guide + runbook + sales one-pager.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advisor/phase1 -> staging at 2024-06-10T18:00Z :rocket:

Eric (Eng): I'll post a short RFC today breaking work into rec-gen backend, read-only dashboard, and eval-webhook integration.

Jana (PM): Thanks. Keep Phase 1 tight and non-invasive; we'll iterate based on pilot feedback.
